{DRAFT}
⌈
The
FC Crypto
allows to encode and decode
ASN.1
-based standard formats (like [41, PKCS#8], [42, PKCS#12]), as specified in
[43, X.680], [44, X.682], and [45, X.683]. The
CryptoAPI
allows an application or
Functional Cluster
to select the encoding.
